decision_reasons: Development tasks regress in total tokens and calls versus the fresh baseline.
One map answer is rejected by a valid source-anchored model review; its open_for_serve admission claim contradicts the cited source.
One productive producer timeout has unreported usage; one model assessment has an invalid source anchor.
Human reference labels are pending and sample size is small.

intervention: Bundle: smaller grouped query shortlist plus direct-read and uncovered-range instruction. No isolated causal claim for ranking versus instruction.
limitations: Two tasks were inspected during selector development; two new tasks were not used to tune selector.
One attempt per task/condition; four independent tasks total, only two holdout tasks.
Served model/effort, billing cost, model rounds and host-level isolation are unobserved.
Same requested model family produces and reviews answers; model assessments are not human labels.
tool_count_contract: mcp_calls counts unique calls seen by the adapter; mcp_completed_calls counts raw completed MCP events. Pending calls are not completed work.

old_pilot.scope: Historical development pilot; two repetitions on two tasks. Its +13.6% tokens and +22.5% calls are not a concurrent third arm.
